queries.sql: SELECT c.*, p.revoked AS parent_revoked, p.expires_at AS parent_expiry, p.account_id AS parent_account_id, p.account_auth_epoch AS parent_account_auth_epoch, m.account_id AS bound_account_id, a.active AS account_active, a.revision AS account_revision, a.auth_epoch AS current_account_auth_epoch FROM credentials c LEFT JOIN credentials p ON p.hash=c.parent_hash LEFT JOIN member_accounts m ON m.room_id=c.room_id AND m.member_id=c.member_id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id=m.account_id WHERE c.hash=?

SELECT sequence, CASE WHEN instr(projection, ',"messages":[') > 1 AND json_valid(substr(projection, 1, instr(projection, ',"messages":[') - 1) || '}') THEN json_extract(substr(projection, 1, instr(projection, ',"messages":[') - 1) || '}', '$.room.ownerId', '$.members', '$.room.historyVisibility', '$.room.historyDefaultsVersion') END AS authority FROM rooms WHERE id=?
SELECT id FROM membership_invitations WHERE room_id=? AND intended_member_id=? AND status='accepted'
SELECT origin FROM member_accounts WHERE room_id=? AND member_id=?

WITH private_posts AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id,json_extract(body,'$.data.messageId') AS messageId FROM events WHERE room_id=? AND json_extract(body,'$.type')='message.posted' AND COALESCE(json_extract(body,'$.data.toMemberId'),'')<>'' ) SELECT json_extract(e.body,'$.actorId') AS actor, max(json_extract(e.body,'$.at')) AS at FROM events e WHERE e.room_id=? AND NOT ( (json_extract(e.body,'$.type')='message.posted' AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.body,'$.data.toMemberId'),'')<>'') OR (json_extract(e.body,'$.type') IN ('message.edited','message.deleted','message.redacted','poll.voted','message.pinned','message.unpinned') AND COALESCE((json_extract(e.body,'$.data.messageId') IN (SELECT messageId FROM private_posts) OR json_extract(e.body,'$.data.messageId') IN (SELECT id FROM private_posts)),0)) ) GROUP BY actor
SELECT json_extract(body,'$.data.memberId') AS member, MIN(json_extract(body,'$.at')) AS at FROM events WHERE room_id=? AND json_extract(body,'$.type')='member.added' GROUP BY member

SELECT sequence, CASE WHEN instr(projection, ',"messages":[') > 1 AND json_valid(substr(projection, 1, instr(projection, ',"messages":[') - 1) || '}') THEN json_extract(substr(projection, 1, instr(projection, ',"messages":[') - 1) || '}', '$.room.ownerId', '$.members', '$.room.historyVisibility', '$.room.historyDefaultsVersion') END AS authority FROM rooms WHERE id=?
SELECT id FROM membership_invitations WHERE room_id=? AND intended_member_id=? AND status='accepted'
SELECT origin FROM member_accounts WHERE room_id=? AND member_id=?

SELECT sequence, CASE WHEN instr(projection, ',"messages":[') > 1 AND json_valid(substr(projection, 1, instr(projection, ',"messages":[') - 1) || '}') THEN json_extract(substr(projection, 1, instr(projection, ',"messages":[') - 1) || '}', '$.room.ownerId', '$.members', '$.room.historyVisibility', '$.room.historyDefaultsVersion') END AS authority FROM rooms WHERE id=?
SELECT sequence FROM rooms WHERE id=?
SELECT item_json FROM work_claims WHERE room_id=? ORDER BY rowid ASC

WITH private_posts AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id,json_extract(body,'$.data.messageId') AS messageId FROM events WHERE room_id=? AND json_extract(body,'$.type')='message.posted' AND COALESCE(json_extract(body,'$.data.toMemberId'),'')<>'' ) SELECT json_extract(e.body,'$.actorId') AS actor, max(json_extract(e.body,'$.at')) AS at FROM events e WHERE e.room_id=? AND NOT ( (json_extract(e.body,'$.type')='message.posted' AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.body,'$.data.toMemberId'),'')<>'') OR (json_extract(e.body,'$.type') IN ('message.edited','message.deleted','message.redacted','poll.voted','message.pinned','message.unpinned') AND COALESCE((json_extract(e.body,'$.data.messageId') IN (SELECT messageId FROM private_posts) OR json_extract(e.body,'$.data.messageId') IN (SELECT id FROM private_posts)),0)) ) GROUP BY actor
SELECT json_extract(body,'$.data.memberId') AS member, MIN(json_extract(body,'$.at')) AS at FROM events WHERE room_id=? AND json_extract(body,'$.type')='member.added' GROUP BY member
